hook: Byaaj Pe Bhi Byaaj Milta Hai!

points.title: Simple vs Compound
points.text: Simple mein sirf asli paise pe byaaj. Compound mein byaaj pe bhi byaaj.

points.title: Rs 1 Lakh Ka Example
points.text: 10% saalana, 10 saal: simple se Rs 2 lakh, compound se lagbhag Rs 2.59 lakh.

points.title: Rule of 72
points.text: 72 ko rate se divide karo. 10% pe paisa lagbhag 7 saal mein double.

takeaway: Jaldi shuru karo, time hi asli jaadu hai.
